content.title: About
content.content: Lettuce (Lactuca sativa) is a leafy vegetable widely used in fresh dishes. In this version the leaves are slightly wilted and are drizzled with a bacon‑based dressing that adds a smoky, savory flavor and a crunchy texture.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Slight wilting can concentrate the leaf’s aroma, giving a richer taste.
Bacon dressing is often finished with a touch of maple syrup to balance salty and sweet notes.
Lettuce belongs to the Asteraceae family and is one of the oldest cultivated crops.
The combination of fresh greens and smoked meat is popular in American cuisine, especially in Caesar‑style salads.
Lettuce leaves can be up to 95% water, making them an excellent source of hydration.

items.title: Rich in vitamin K
items.content: Lettuce provides a high amount of vitamin K, essential for blood clotting and bone health.

items.title: Low‑calorie
items.content: One cup of lettuce contains about 15 calories, making it ideal for weight‑management diets.

items.title: Source of folate
items.content: Folate supports normal cell division and is especially important during pregnancy.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Lettuce contains lutein and zeaxanthin, which protect the eyes from UV damage.

items.title: Bacon adds protein
items.content: The bacon dressing contributes additional protein and iron.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Bacon is often salty, so the dish can be high in sodium, which may be a concern for hypertension.

items.title: Saturated fats
items.content: Bacon contains saturated fats and should be consumed in moderation.

items.title: Meat allergy
items.content: People with pork allergy or sensitivity to animal products may react to the dressing.

items.title: Bacterial spoilage
items.content: Wilted lettuce can spoil faster; keep it refrigerated and consume within 1‑2 days.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the salad cold, drizzling the bacon dressing just before serving. Add toasted nuts, pumpkin seeds, or a splash of lemon juice for extra balance.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the lettuce leaves in an airtight container in the fridge, separate from the dressing. Keep the bacon dressing in a sealed jar and use within 3‑4 days.
